extracted.name: Simple Salmon Patties
extracted.description: These simple salmon patties are made with canned salmon, egg, and self-rising flour, then pan-fried until crisp and golden brown.
instruction_lines: Combine salmon, egg, and flour in a medium bowl; mix well. Form mixture into patties.
Heat about 1/4 inch oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Fry patties in batches until browned, turning once. Drain on paper towels and serve.
